system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an AWS Lambda function named 'order-processor' triggered by an SQS queue, written in Python 3.12.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an AWS Lambda function named 'order-processor' triggered by an SQS queue, written in Python 3.12.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for order-processor Lambda function

Resources:
  OrderProcessorLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: order-processor
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt OrderProcessorLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
            # Process order logic here
            print(event)
            return {
              'statusCode': 200,
              'statusMessage': 'OK'
            }
      Description: Order processor Lambda function
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 128

  OrderProcessorLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: execution-role-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  OrderProcessorSQSQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: order-processor-queue

  OrderProcessorSQSQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref OrderProcessorSQSQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !GetAtt OrderProcessorSQSQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'

  OrderProcessorLambdaEventSourceMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt OrderProcessorSQSQueue.Arn
      FunctionName: !Ref OrderProcessorLambdaFunction
      Enabled: true

Outputs:
  OrderProcessorLambdaFunctionArn:
    Value: !GetAtt OrderProcessorLambdaFunction.Arn
    Description: ARN of the order-processor Lambda function
  OrderProcessorSQSQueueUrl:
    Value: !GetAtt OrderProcessorSQSQueue.Url
    Description: URL of the order-processor SQS queue
